Hi team,

I attached a first-pass manager synthesis for Alex's biannual. The doc is intentionally concise — my goal is to capture the core signals for calibration: scope expansion, quality of mentorship, and suggested stretch areas.

Quick asks:
- Rishi: can you confirm the competency ratings and the proposed promotion timeline language?
- Mina: anything in here we should move to a private HR-only note (compensation context, confidential coaching items)?
- Alex: please ignore the attached draft for now — this is manager-facing. If you want to share any self-assessment highlights with me directly, happy to incorporate.

Key context summary (TL;DR):
- Impact: consistently shipping infra initiatives that reduced LLM inference latency by ~18% in Q1–Q2.
- Leadership: stepped into mentoring role for new infra hires; needs more structured 1:1s to scale mentorship.
- Growth areas: cross-team communication and formalizing runbooks.

I've left inline comments in the attachment; prefer to keep the thread internal. We can meet Monday to finalize before the calibration packet is submitted.

Thanks —
Lauren

Redwood Inference

Thanks Lauren — good start. A few inline points:

1) Competency / rating: I think "Exceeds Expectations" on system design and ownership is fair; for "Cross-team influence" I'd land at "Meets Expectations" with a clear note that this is near-term growth area.

2) Promotion timing: agree with recommending eligibility for Senior Staff discussion next cycle. Wording suggestion: "Recommend candidate be considered for Senior Engineer banding in the next promotion cycle contingent on sustained cross-team project leadership."

3) Mentor coaching: I added a short paragraph on making mentorship more repeatable (group onboarding sessions, templated 1:1 agenda).

One operational ask: can we avoid naming specific customer incidents in the main summary? Better to reference them generically and include incident details in a separate HR doc.

If useful, I'm happy to hop on Monday at 9am to review before calibration.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the heads-up and the draft. A couple of HR notes:

- Please remove compensation rationale and any references to salary bands from the shared manager summary. That content should go into the private HR packet that only the compensation committee sees.
- Any wording about formal disciplinary conversations or coaching history must live in the confidential HR folder. If you need, I can create a private Google folder and move sensitive items there.
- Also, when referencing incidents, anonymize customer/partner names and include ticket/incident IDs only in the private notes.

I can take the attached PDF, scrub the sensitive paragraphs, and produce a manager-facing redacted version before calibration. If you want me to do that, please confirm and I'll share a link to the redacted file by EOD.

Mina
Mina Haddad
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference

Related: per our data retention policy, avoid embedding full PII in thread bodies. Use the private folder for any PII-containing docs.

Thanks both — helpful guidance.

Mina: please do go ahead and produce the redacted manager-facing PDF; that would be great. Once you share the link, I'll swap the attachment in the calibration packet.

Rishi: I accepted your wording change on promotion timing and softened the incident language per Mina's note. I also added a recommended timeline: "target promotion discussion Q4 2027 contingent on two cross-functional deliveries and continued mentorship outcomes."

Next steps:
- Mina to post redacted PDF to private folder and share link (by EOD).
- Rishi and I to review final doc in the Monday 9am sync and lock for calibration.
- I will not share this thread with Alex; Alex will be told the summary after calibration decisions are final.

Thanks —
Lauren
